about: File retry window: an operation the OS refuses for a moment (a scanner, an indexer or a sync client holding the file) is tried again until `patience_ms` has passed. Each case is one operation that is refused for its first `refused_ms`, with a refusal that is `transient` (retried) or `other` (returned at once). `expect` is `ok` or `error`. A refusal that ends within the window is outlasted — the last attempt is made when the window closes — so the expectations hold whatever pauses an implementation takes between attempts; `attempts` is given only where every implementation must agree on it. No case waits past its window.

cases.name: refused for most of the window: outlasted
refused until the window closes: the last attempt at its end succeeds
refused past the window: the refusal is returned
any other error is returned at once
no patience and not refused: one attempt
